[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making a big batch of lentil soup, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Basic Lentil Soup Recipe: 1 cup dried green or brown lentils, 4 cups vegetable broth, 1 onion (chopped), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 carrots (chopped), 2 celery stalks (chopped), 1 can diced tomatoes (14.5 oz), 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp dried rosemary, salt and pepper to taste.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using a large pot (6-8 quarts), soaking lentils (optional), sautéing aromatics, adding lentils and broth, cooking for 30-40 minutes, seasoning, cooling, and portioning for storage.
